question: To treat muscular strain, a physiotherapist uses a lamp that emits electromagnetic radiation which causes a heating effect in the tissue. If the lamp operates at a temperature of $2000 \text{ K}$, utilizing Wien's Displacement Law ($\lambda_{max} T = 2.9 \times 10^{-3} \text{ m K}$), what is the peak wavelength and the type of wave?
